notes: PERFORM like ROLI Studio Player: the Keys page grew SMART CHORDS (in-scale keys play full diatonic triads/7ths — works in every scale — with +Bass and a strum slider) and an ARPEGGIATOR (1/8, triplet or 1/16 at the shared tempo; up/down/up-down; 1-2 octaves; Hold latch) — both layered over ANY voice, grand or the MPE synth presets. Studio phase 2 starters: + Synth / + Drums / + Sampler buttons right on the Timeline and FL-style CLIP RESIZE (drag a clip's right edge, snap-aware). LUMI fix: when LUMI sync is on, the app no longer fights the keyboard's own display — the note-light modes auto-stand-down, so the SysEx scale colors (root + in-scale, the hardware's two custom slots) show clean.
